This '''alien race''' was a race of humanoids similar in appearance to [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]], [[Sunesi]] or [[Vultan]] with thick cranial nodules on their bald plates. [[Rur/Legends|Rur]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Blind Fury" />
